correctness.rationale: Strong simplicial domination removes untouched vertices. Path endpoint forcing eliminates all full transversals; cyclic forcing leaves two per component. Two nerve lemmas reduce the Alexander dual to a cross-polytope boundary; integral Alexander duality and simple connectivity give a single sphere by Hurewicz–Whitehead. Restoring isolated color classes suspends. Complete mod-two matrices match 57 finite cases. Finite checks do not establish the universal claim.
